requirement: Render the tree-lined town skyline as a 19th-century etching, with crisp black ink on lightly aged ivory paper. Define rooftops, domes, and towers with fine contour lines, and build the shaded foliage with dense crosshatching. Replace all color with monochrome tones, leaving the bright sky mostly unmarked for contrast.
annotation_note: Retrospective development evaluation. Source timeline reviewed before this scoring run; outputs already existed. Not a prospective held-out annotation.
